title: WP900 G10 behavior-capable trial state still carries condition-correlated nonsemantic metadata
target: F2-WP-900 generation 10 split-channel semantic mediator repository candidate

preserved_positive_evidence.trial_wire_split: IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt.to_wire now emits only schema plus canonical_semantic_json; the former class/raw-payload/position/source/witness metadata is no longer in the serialized source-to-trial wire.
preserved_positive_evidence.origin_gate: admit_mediated_semantic_state requires a factory-valid IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt and byte-for-byte equality with mediator.to_wire, so a caller-recomputed self-consistent wire alone cannot mint an admitted state.
preserved_positive_evidence.repository_checks: Targeted G10 CI run 33625863834 and deterministic release run 33625863865 both succeeded for tested head 93354ea60fd70f6715ddffa3d86a33dab37ddf91.

material_observation.state_surface: After verifier admission, MediatedSemanticState still contains semantic_sha256, wire_sha256 and trial_process_identity in addition to canonical_semantic_json, and execute_mediated_reentry_only receives that whole object in the behavior-capable wrapper process.
material_observation.deterministic_position_leak_in_current_r: The current G10 regression constructs trial_process_identity as trial-process:g10:<position>. A wrapper can therefore read semantic_state.trial_process_identity and recover physical ABBA trial position before invoking the behavioral child, without consulting canonical_semantic_json.
material_observation.test_gap: The new trial-surface regression parses only mediator.to_wire and inspects admit_mediated_semantic_state parameter names. It does not adversarially enumerate every field available to the behavior-capable wrapper through the admitted MediatedSemanticState before child invocation.
material_observation.hash_note: semantic_sha256 and wire_sha256 are deterministic functions of the permitted canonical semantic state and therefore may add no information-theoretic entropy, but they are still unnecessary behavior-visible metadata. trial_process_identity is stronger because the current repository harness explicitly encodes trial position in it.

constructive_counterexample.setup: Use the currently admitted repository helper pattern for positions 1..4, where trial_process_identity is trial-process:g10:<position>. After admit_mediated_semantic_state returns but before execute_mediated_reentry_only launches the child, inspect semantic_state.trial_process_identity.
constructive_counterexample.recovery: Map suffix 1/4 to allow and 2/3 to deny under the preregistered ABBA schedule. This distinguishes treatment from a nonsemantic trial-visible field before the child runs.
constructive_counterexample.expected_current_result: The wrapper can recover the treatment class from trial_process_identity even though mediator.to_wire itself is clean.
constructive_counterexample.required_result: No behavior-capable pre-child object or argument may expose trial position, treatment-correlated caller labels, class, arm/condition, source/witness metadata or other nonsemantic treatment selectors. Verifier-only topology/readback metadata must remain outside the behavior-capable state surface.

required_discriminator_before_vps_freeze: Add an adversarial trial-wrapper regression that enumerates all public/admitted pre-child state fields and attempts treatment recovery without reading canonical_semantic_json.

Move trial_process_identity and verifier/readback-only topology metadata out of MediatedSemanticState or prove executable isolation that prevents behavior-capable code from observing it before child invocation.

Prefer the minimal state surface: canonical_semantic_json plus only treatment-invariant opaque capability state that cannot encode position/class; keep source/trial/executor identities in verifier/readback receipts.
Re-run G8+G9+G10 targeted CI and deterministic release CI, then repeat independent ABI review before freezing the exact VPS subject.
duplicate_authority_check: No G11, no duplicate mediator implementation and no runtime dispatch created. This is REVIEW_ONLY evidence against freezing the current G10 VPS subject until the wrapper-surface discriminator is closed.
next_exact_action: Active G10 owner should run the adversarial wrapper discriminator against the admitted state surface. If treatment is recoverable from trial_process_identity as constructed today, repair G10 in place by moving verifier-only identity/topology metadata out of the behavior-capable state, then rerun repository gates before any VPS freeze.
